Shipping times quoted include up to 2 business days for your order to be processed and prepared for shipment. We are unable to expedite shipments or guarantee delivery dates on parcel packages. Room of Choice Delivery: Orders including oversized items will be shipped by a large parcel carrier and include Room of Choice Delivery. Our delivery carrier will contact you to schedule a date and time. A skilled delivery team will bring your items inside and place them in the room of your choosing (upstairs carrying limit of two flights of stairs, up to 15 steps each). Unboxing, debris removal, and assembly are not included in this service. Tracking & Orders: An automated tracking email will be sent to the email address submitted with your order once the carrier picks up the order. What's your return and refund policy?

Agent response: Hello there! I'd be happy to provide you with all the details about our return and refund policy. We want you to feel confident and happy with your Namesake product! You can find our full policy on our Returns & Exchanges page, but here's a summary of the key points: Return Window & Eligibility: If you purchased directly from namesakehome.com, please contact us within 30 days of delivery to initiate a return. Items must be sent back in new condition and in original packaging, with all components included, to qualify for a refund. Please do not modify the product in any way. For mattresses, they must remain unopened and in their original packaging to be eligible for return. Items Ineligible for Return/Exchange: Please note that some items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged: All Bedding products including sheets, blankets, wall decals, and changing pad covers Items marked as final sale. Newton Baby Mattresses (these are final sale) 'Extend' Warranty Fees Free Returns & Package Protection Premiums Gift Cards (Gift cards are non-refundable and final sale. You can find more details on our Gift Card page.) Return Shipping Costs: We offer Return & Exchange Coverage which you can purchase at checkout. If you have this coverage, your return shipping label will be covered for eligible items. If you choose not to buy return & exchange coverage, you can still process a return, but you will need to cover the cost of the return shipping label, which typically is about 25% of the retail value of the item. How to Initiate a Return/Exchange: To start the process, please visit our Namesake Returns Portal. After your request has been accepted, you will receive your return label and instructions via email. Refund Process: Once your return is received and inspected, you can expect to receive a refund to the payment choice you selected (Credit Card or Store Credit) within 3-5 days after it has been delivered back to our facilities. If you need to return a purchase made with a gift card, full refunds will be issued back to the original gift card, as well as any other payment methods used. For partial refunds, credit/debit cards will be refunded first, and any remaining balance will go back to the gift card(s). We recommend keeping the original packaging until you are sure you won't need to make a return or exchange, as this greatly simplifies the process. Is there anything else I can help you with regarding returns or anything else today? 😊
